Replaced the placeholder static policy pages on the accounts surface with
real content, ahead of the minds-v0.4.2 production connector deploy (the
pages ship via the deploy's frontend build of `frontend/public/`):

`code-of-conduct.html` now carries the full Minds Code of Conduct
(encouraged uses, community guidelines, prohibited activity, enforcement
ladder, appeals/abuse contacts, beta disclaimer).

`privacy-policy.html` now carries the beta privacy addendum (Explorer-plan
product-data export, Free-plan collection stance, beta caveats, and a link
to the full policy at imbue.com/privacy) instead of the placeholder
summary.

`terms-of-service.html` remains a placeholder.
